{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Farmers and ranchers are among this country's leading conservationists.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Modern farm practices and technologies, supported by programs from the Department of Agriculture, have led to reduced erosion.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Modern farm practices and technologies, supported by programs from the Department of Agriculture, have led to improved water quality.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Modern farm practices and technologies, supported by programs from the Department of Agriculture, have led to improved air quality.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Modern farm practices and technologies, supported by programs from the Department of Agriculture, have led to increased wildlife habitat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Modern farm practices and technologies, supported by programs from the Department of Agriculture, have maintained improved agricultural yields.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Stewardship of the land by farmers and ranchers benefits everyone.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to conservation policies based on the preservation, not the restriction, of working lands.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ranching on public lands must be fostered, developed, and encouraged.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Providing for an abundant water supply for America's farmers, ranchers, and their communities is necessary.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Farming and ranching remain high-risk endeavors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Farming and ranching cannot be isolated from market forces.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No segment of agriculture can expect treatment so favorable that it seriously disadvantages workers in other trades.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Federal programs to assist farmers in managing risk must be as cost-effective as they are functional.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Federal programs to assist farmers in managing risk must offer tools that can improve producers' ability to operate when times are tough.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Federal programs to assist farmers in managing risk must remain affordable to the taxpayers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The expansion of agricultural exports through the vigorous opening of new markets around the world is the surest path to farm security.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
